Maya Torres: Weekly health check for Helios (quick): p95/p99 by route/model, streaming vs non-streaming. Headline: streaming p99 on `chat.respond` jumped to ~740ms on Tue evening; other routes stable. Embeddings fine.

Ravi Kapoor: Pulled telemetry for last 7 days (Mon-Sun):
- chat.respond (redwood-1.3) streaming: p95=200ms, p99=740ms
- chat.respond (redwood-1.3) non-streaming: p95=100ms, p99=260ms
- embed.create (redwood-emb-1) non-streaming: p95=80ms, p99=130ms
- summarize (redwood-1.3) streaming: p95=150ms, p99=330ms

Jules Park: Traces point to increased backend_fetch time when concurrent streaming sessions >100 and KV cache hit rate drops ~25% during the spike window (20:45-21:10 UTC Tue).

Omar Diaz: Log snippet around 2025-02-11T20:48Z:
```
2025-02-11T20:46:12Z pool=shared-streaming active_streams=117 kv_cache_hit=false backend_fetch_ms=480
2025-02-11T20:46:13Z host=inf-09 cpu_steal=12.4% threads=88
```

Zoe (telemetry-bot): Alert: Helios chat.respond streaming p99 > 700ms at 2025-02-11T20:46:12Z. Baseline p99=240ms.

Maya Torres: Impact: onboarding cohort A scheduled in 7 days — CS flagged renewal risk if tails persist. Cost note: daily spend on Tue increased 38% due to token surge.

Ravi Kapoor: Quick mitigations suggested:
1) Move Helios streaming traffic to a small dedicated pool for 72h trial.
2) Increase KV pre-warm for sessions with >50 active streams.
3) Apply soft concurrency cap per-account at 110 with graceful degradation.
4) Investigate reclaim policy on shared nodes (OOMs?).

Jules Park: I'll add a runtime flag to reduce backend_fetch parallelism when streams>80 to avoid saturating IO. Low-risk toggle.

Omar Diaz: I'll validate host metrics and pin noisy nodes out of the pool. ETA 6h for initial remediation.

Maya Torres: Action items:
- @Omar Diaz: isolate noisy hosts + report (ETA 6h).
- @Jules Park: push runtime flag in staging (ETA 8h), then prod if green.
- @Ravi Kapoor: prepare customer note + cost delta for dedicated pool (ETA 12h).

Ravi Kapoor: Customer message draft: "We detected a transient tail in your streaming chat route during a token burst. We're running a dedicated streaming pool and a runtime tweak; will update within 48h with metrics and recommendation." Approve?

Maya Torres: :+1: Keep it short and offer the read-only dashboard. Also confirm whether they want proactive scaling enabled.

Zoe (telemetry-bot): Next alert threshold: p99 > 500ms will notify channel. Will post a follow-up if the dedicated pool trial is live or if tails persist.

Maya Torres: Thanks team — next sync in 24h or on Zoe alert.
